title: Win-Backs on Purpose: Turn Lost and Declining Accounts Into a Revenue Engine
summary: Turn lost and declining accounts into a revenue engine with an always-on, data-driven win-back motion. A webinar from Harte Hanks and Corporate Visions.
body_markdown:
Webinar


Tim Riesterer


Chief Strategy Officer
Corporate Visions


Alex Gill


Global Head of Strategy
Harte Hanks


Join Corporate Visions and Harte Hanks to learn how to turn win-back and revenue recovery into an ongoing engine, not a one-time initiative.


[Register for the Webinar](https://corporatevisions.com/resources/win-backs/win-backs-on-purpose/)


When a customer leaves or starts buying less, most teams move on. They chase new logos, lean harder on active accounts or wait for the customer to come back on their own. But lost and declining accounts are not the same, and they are rarely gone for good. Each one carries signals about what changed and what the customer needs now. In this webinar, Alex Gill, Global Head of Strategy at Harte Hanks, joins Tim Riesterer, Chief Strategy Officer at Corporate Visions, to show how to make win-back its own revenue motion: an always-on, data-driven system that spots revenue risk early, learns from customer behavior, coordinates outreach and improves with every cycle. You’ll learn how to:


- Tell fully lost customers apart from declining or disengaging ones, and diagnose the cause before you reach out
- Build a credible “we’ve changed” message backed by content, channels, people, technology and AI
- Set up a learning loop with control groups and ongoing measurement
- Run win-back as a distinct motion with its own signals, segments, messaging, metrics and cadence


[Alex Gill, Global Head of Strategy](https://www.hartehanks.com/author/alex-gill/)


Client-facing, results-orientated, strategic leader – specializing in B2B services, products, marketing and revenue generation with a track record of commercial and operational success at VP/Senior Director level.
